proof_summary: The order-7 recurrence is solved as a quadratic with a period-5 correction, reducing the sequence values to five residue-dependent polynomial formulas. Truncated \(\operatorname{artanh}\) expansions and monotone Euler–Maclaurin tails bound the harmonic expression between explicit rational functions; positive-coefficient rational inequalities in each residue class then place its reciprocal in the unique unit interval determining the required floor.
